description: Faced with systemic dysfunction, zero political capital, and repeated failures of oversight, senior AI researchers and engineers across multiple EU member states begin publicly resigning from public-sector AI initiatives and critical evaluation bodies. They cite irreversible institutional decay, compromised security, and the impossibility of ethical stewardship under current conditions. This wave of desertion further degrades the EU's capacity to respond.

A model-generated cyberattack exploiting sovereign update mechanisms has already occurred, and institutional, political, and technological fragility converge into a total crisis of oversight. Auditors confirm the Sovereign Core was compromised months before activation, and red-team reviews are now mandated. This instability in foundational EU AI infrastructure persists and escalates, undermining confidence in further deployment.
